# Rule 3 - Respect consent, and accesibility statements:
\n
- This server allows adult themes, and not everyone is here for that. If someone signals via LOOC, their consent menu, or in character that they are not interested; you must respect that and shift the encounter.
- This server has accessibility statements, make an effort to read them so actions you take don't have a negative effect on the other player. If this is brought up, and you were unaware you should stop the offending action.
- Impersonation of a character, even via existing in game tools like the voice mask, requires the other party to be explicitly consenting (out of character) and in on the narrative. Most communication and interaction happens over radio on this fork, so some amount of respect for characters being able to represent themselves clearly is needed.
- Conversations and ahelps with admins are also subject to consent, if mature content is relevant to the conversation, ask first before divulging anything about it.
